http:request.doc:name: IDP Get Request
http:request.http:uri-params: #[output application/java --- { executionId : payload.id, "orgId" : p('secure::idp.orgId'), "version" : vars.doc.version, "actionId" : vars.doc.actionId }]

raise-error.description: IDP execution is still in progress; extraction not completed

logger.message: #[output application/json --- { "message": "Request sent to update status of " ++ vars.objectName ++ " in salesforce", ("contentDocumentId": vars.document.contentDocumentId) if(vars.objectName == "content version"), ("checklistLineId": vars.document.checklistLineId) if(vars.objectName == "check list line"), ("fileName": vars.document.fileName) if(vars.objectName != "claim"), ("status": if ( vars.objectName == "content version" ) vars.contentVersionStatus else vars.checkListLineStatus) if(vars.objectName != "claim") }]

logger.doc:name: Response Logger
Logging Content Version Message
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": if ( !isEmpty(vars.contentVersionMessage) ) vars.contentVersionMessage else if ( !isEmpty(vars.failure) ) vars.failure else "Document has been processed successfully", "fileName": vars.document.fileName, }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- (vars.failureReason default [] ++ [{ "fileName": vars.document.fileName, "message": vars.failure }]) filter ((item, index) -> !isEmpty(item.message))

logger.doc:name: Logging Content Version Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Document content version status updated successfully", "fileName": vars.document.fileName, "status": payload.successful }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- (vars.fileStatus default [] ++ [{ "fileName": vars.document.fileName, "status": if ( vars.contentVersionStatus == p('status.failed') ) "Failed" else "Success" }]) filter ((item, index) -> item.status == "Success")

logger.doc:name: Logging Check List Line Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Document check list line status updated successfully", "fileName": vars.document.fileName, "status": payload.successful }]
